# rixl_project (Data Source)

Fetches details, status, and configuration of a specific Rixl project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_project" "main" {
  org_id = var.rixl_org_id
  id     = var.rixl_project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `custom_domain` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `regions` (List of String)
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. "2024-12-25T12:00:00Z".
- `video_quality` (String)
